items.t: Hybrid warning light or hard start in freezing weather
items.job: Replace hybrid IGCT relay or hybrid battery junction block (per Lexus bulletins)
items.note: Which part depends on the car: bulletin L-SB-0021-20 (2019-2020 UX 250h, hard start, codes U011087/U029387) replaces a small relay, 0.2 hr; bulletin L-SB-0055-23 (2019-2023 UX 250h, codes P1C8449/P300449) replaces the hybrid battery junction block, 1.1 hr. Relay $22-$29 and junction block $320-$444 (LexusPartsNow sale vs list). Hybrid parts are often still under the hybrid warranty, so ask the dealer first.

items.job: Clean motor cable terminals and fit new bolts (bulletin L-SB-0006-20)
items.note: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0006-20 lists 2.0 hours; parts are only new bolts and a terminal cap (small cost, not included). Usually covered by the hybrid component warranty.

items.t: Check engine light from the fuel pressure sensor
items.note: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0012-22 (2019 UX 250h, code P019064) says to update the engine computer software, not replace it; 0.7 hours including a test drive.
